rafa issue unblock — take spec:blocked off an issue whose blockers have all
  closed

Usage:
  rafa issue unblock [n] [--all] [--yes]

Description:
  Reads the "Blocked by: #24 #26" line of an issue labelled spec:blocked on the
  GitHub board, asks the board for each blocker's state, and when every blocker
  is closed asks whether to remove spec:blocked and removes it on a yes. With a
  blocker still open it names it and changes nothing. An issue labelled
  spec:blocked whose "Blocked by:" line is missing, names itself or names an id
  the board has no issue for is reported and never guessed at. Without a
  terminal and without `--yes` it asks nothing and writes nothing. `--yes`
  answers the question yes without putting it, terminal or not, and names the
  blockers it read closed; it never removes spec:blocked from an issue with a
  blocker open or a line it refuses to guess at. With `--output=json` the
  outcome of each issue is the data of the terminal result event. With
  board.relationships set to native it reads nothing and writes nothing: GitHub
  clears a blocker by itself when the blocking issue closes.

Arguments:
  n   string
      The issue number on the GitHub board. Left out, `--all` reads every
      blocked issue.

Flags:
  --all   boolean
      Read every open issue labelled spec:blocked, asking about each one in
      turn.
  --yes   boolean
      Answer the question yes without putting it, so spec:blocked comes off
      every issue whose blockers are all closed, with no terminal needed. An
      open blocker or an unreadable "Blocked by:" line still changes nothing.

Examples:
  rafa issue unblock 57
      Asks whether to remove spec:blocked from #57 when every issue its "Blocked
      by:" line names is closed.
  rafa issue unblock 57 --yes
      Removes spec:blocked from #57 with no question when every blocker it names
      is closed.
  rafa issue unblock --all
      Walks every open blocked issue on the board, asking about each one whose
      blockers have all closed.

Outputs:
  text, json

See also:
  rafa issue list, rafa issue show, rafa issue create, rafa issue comment, rafa
  issue move, rafa issue ready, rafa issue check, rafa issue edit
